correctness.rationale: The 2-star-forming condition on C_n is checked by a length-five local predicate for each omitted vertex, while inclusion-minimality requires at least one omitted-vertex failure after each selected-vertex deletion. For n>=9 these assemble into the exact nine-bit window predicate, giving a directed 256-state overlapping-eight-bit graph. Independently rebuilt all 512 windows and obtained precisely 332 permitted arcs. The supplied 256-character potential has nonnegative digit heights 0..4 and satisfies 3x_center-2<=h(next)-h(current) on every arc; summation around an arbitrary cyclic word yields 3|S|<=2n. The tight graph has 242 arcs, and independent reachability SCC computation gives exactly two cyclic SCCs, simple 3-cycle {109,182,219} and simple 6-cycle {60,121,158,207,231,243}; therefore equality words are rotations of 110, and iff 6|n also 111100. Direct definition enumeration of all subsets for n=3..12 (including all n<9) confirmed floor(2n/3), 3/9 counts for multiples of 3 and the 6-length anomalous non-2-independent class. Repeating 110 with suitable endings attains the bound for all n. The finite-state potential is a complete all-length certificate, whereas small-n enumeration alone is not.
